Name: Canna Cafe
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Wow! The votes in, it has been decided by the townies to add a new cafe to Pelican town.. a totally legal one! Some of the townies do have words about the Cafe..

**This mod has been in the work for a few months & is still getting updated.**

Shop is located by community center, in the right front corner, best to start a new game so nothing blocks building. Not compatible with SVE. Will make a optional file sooner or later to buy seeds elsewhere if you don't want building

Thanks a bunch to Aimon1111 for creating my custom building, sprites, and helping me out a bunch along the way!
You should check out their lovely mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673?tab=user+files]HERE[/url] and if you want something created custom check them out [url=https://aimon-commission-info.carrd.co/]HERE[/url]! 
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou/about-me?gameId=1303]
mrtaiyou[/url]  for the bread roll and donuts added! Follow [url=https://ko-fi.com/ty_ty#]here [/url]to see more of there work!

So I wanted a cafe in game but also more realistic to grow my cannabis farm. So this mod includes cafe shop, things to buy from shop, artisan goods, foods, crafting recipes, cooking recipes (Unlock at farm level 5), and decor plants!

Seeds are expensive! The point is to invest in and make your profit back, grow your empire!

The cafe actually has two shops The Canna Cafe the actual coffee shop where you can buy infused and regular goodies and then also a back room where you can talk to the guy in the back and he will sell you things.. For example if you wanted to start your own cannabis or cannabis goods business he'll sell you some seeds to start you out! Or you can buy big quantities of cannabis from him and just sell it (He sells it to you for a little bit cheaper price so you can go out and start your business!)- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19309]I would suggest a mod like Market Town to actually sell to townies/npcs.[/url]

You can make cbd oil, hemp oil, hemp milk, hemp butter, Cannabutter, cannabis infused liqueur & more! 

There are only two types of cannabis crops plus hemp seeds. - I didn't want to over add more crops but if you want more types just let me know! 
Cannabis & Lavender Haze ( it cost a bit more to grow so more profit)

There are also Cannabis Jars which you can't buy from the store you have to craft them yourself once you hit a certain farm level (2) and then also crafting glass jars which you need a certain mining level to craft (2) or you can buy your jar supplies from Gus at the Saloon for an upcharge.

Things to Add:
More Dialogue
Ways to make your own bags of cannabis (plz suggest ideas)
Gift Tastes (working on it)
Special Orders/Quests
Adding more cooking recipes- So far you can make hemp milk, brownies, & muffins
